population_note_text: Books population (optional, cancelled and post-dated vouchers excluded). Put to use assumed to be the purchase/voucher date unless the client's setup gives a put-to-use date for that voucher.

figures.definition_text: Total Income-tax Act depreciation across every mapped block, INCLUDING additions the books show as paid in cash; the Act figure only if that payment mode is shown not to be cash.

Total Income-tax Act depreciation applying the s.43(1) second proviso to every addition the books show as paid in cash: the Act figure on the books as recorded. Equal to the total across every mapped block including cash-paid additions when none is flagged.
Additions to block 'plant_machinery_15' put to use at least 180 days before period end (full rate).
Additions to block 'plant_machinery_15' put to use fewer than 180 days before period end (half rate, s.32(1) second proviso).

Book depreciation credited to block 'plant_machinery_15''s asset ledgers in depreciation-journal vouchers (voucher-level; cross-checked against the Trial Balance total by this test's depreciation tie check).

Tie check: sum of book depreciation credited to asset ledgers in depreciation-journal vouchers, minus the Trial Balance movement of the depreciation expense ledgers set for this client. Non-zero means the depreciation journals do not fully explain the expense ledger's TB movement.
Book depreciation for the year: Trial Balance movement of the depreciation expense ledgers set for this client (never summed from vouchers).
Book depreciation for the year less the total Income-tax Act depreciation across every mapped block (cash-paid additions included).
Book depreciation minus Income-tax Act depreciation for block 'plant_machinery_15'.
Closing Income-tax Act WDV for block 'plant_machinery_15'.
Deletions from block 'plant_machinery_15' (credit lines on its asset ledgers outside a depreciation journal).
Ledgers whose debit is the client's own book depreciation charge (the other side of the voucher that credits each asset ledger for its year's book depreciation).

Income-tax Act depreciation for block 'plant_machinery_15': full rate on (opening plus additions put to use at least 180 days before period end, less deletions, floor 0), half rate on additions put to use fewer than 180 days before period end, net of any deletion spill (s.43(6)).

GST input tax / TCS ledger lines observed alongside a fixed-asset addition line in the same voucher, confirmed to be separate ledger lines never summed into the asset ledger's own debit amount -- verified on data, not merely asserted.

limits_text: Put-to-use date is assumed to be the purchase/voucher date for every addition the client's setup gives no put-to-use date for; no separate commissioning/technical-person certificate is visible in Tally.

Opening WDV per block is a constant supplied in the client's setup, not re-derived from an AY 2025-26 tax computation the books do not carry; confirm it against the filed return/Form 3CD Clause 18(f) for the prior year.
